overview: The Community Preservation Committee approved a small grant application for the Tufts Park Community Garden, re-elected its chair and vice chair, and recommended the FY27 CPA budget.

items.title: Tufts Park Community Garden Expansion
items.summary: Approved a $4,000 small grant application for fence realignment and ten additional beds at Tufts Park, conditioned on the Garden Commission obtaining layout and expansion approval from the Parks Commission.

items.title: Officer Elections
items.summary: Elected Roberta Cameron as chair and Joan Cyr as vice chair for the upcoming year.

items.title: Draft Annual Plan Review
items.summary: The committee discussed the format of the draft annual plan and the possibility of creating an executive summary.

items.title: FY27 CPA Budget
items.summary: Recommended an estimated FY27 CPA budget of approximately $2.38 million, maintaining minimum 10 percent allocations for historic preservation and open space, 25 percent for community housing, and 5 percent for administration.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes of March 10, 2026.
